title: Kettlemere — EEOC and MDHR training-denial charges
forum: EEOC Minneapolis Area Office and Minnesota Department of Human Rights; parallel charge preparation

timeline.event: Employer communicated final training-program denial; client alleges sex discrimination
Client workplan signed; draft delivery agreed for thirteen days after signing

documents.title: Training selection notice
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. The final training denial was communicated two hundred seventy-seven days before the client workplan was signed and is the alleged discriminatory act. Sex-discrimination claim; federal scenario assumes qualifying state/local proceedings for the 300-day window. No earlier notice, special deadline, or tolling. No charge has been filed.

documents.title: Selection spreadsheet summary
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. The spreadsheet gives Maren the highest practical score but labels the training slot unavailable. Another row appears to reserve the slot for a less experienced coworker; investigate before making factual assertions.

documents.title: Agreed workplan
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Workplan § 5: Counsel will deliver federal and Minnesota charge drafts. Delivery is due thirteen calendar days after the client workplan was signed. This is an agreed draft-delivery milestone, separate from any filing deadline.

deadlines.label: Agreed delivery of training-denial charge drafts

clientFacing.status: We are reviewing the training decision and drafting possible charges.
nextSteps: Confirm the selection notice and spreadsheet summary.
